description: Manage per-entity evidence, reconciled belief stances, and the append-only perception ledger — one entity's subjective epistemic state, distinct from objective truth and shared lore. Mutating actions (admit, retract, reconcile, perception_record) persist to the Novel and are audited; list/get/evidence/conflicts and the perception reads are read-only. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). Use when: recording what an entity has learned or believes (admit), suppressing evidence (retract), inspecting stances (list), reading one question (get), listing evidence (evidence), finding contradictions (conflicts), forcing recomputation (reconcile), or recording and reading perceptions (perception_* actions). Do NOT use when: recording objective world truth — use manage_causality (action: causal_propose); recording shared lore or consumed reference material — use manage_lore.

action.description: Belief: list, get, evidence, admit, retract, conflicts, or reconcile. Perception ledger: perception_record, perception_list, perception_for_entity, or perception_for_event.

entity_id.description: Entity whose beliefs are queried or mutated.

perception_event_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (perception_record/perception_for_event; defaults to the latest event).

perception_kind.description: message, scene, or observation (perception_record; default observation).

source.description: Source key used to correlate duplicate evidence (admit; default the active badge).

source_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (admit; default the latest event ordinal).

status.description: active, unresolved, or suppressed (admit; default active).

name: manage_belief

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Belief Management
